europe_now.title: Wildfire Crisis in Europe
europe_now.summary: A wildfire crisis is affecting Europe, particularly Greece. Residents in Greece have been forced to evacuate, leading to growing anger.

europe_now.title: Hungary Faces Energy Crisis After Nuclear Plant Shutdown
europe_now.summary: Hungary has shut down its Paks nuclear plant due to drought and soaring temperatures. The shutdown has triggered an energy crisis in the country, according to the Prime Minister.
